title: Network toxicology and multi-omics identify potential interactions between between air pollutants and interferon-related signaling in tuberculosis.
authors: Cai, Zihan; Ding, Shoupeng; Han, Jian; Gao, Jinghua
one_liner_zh: 该文用网络毒理学与机器学习整合空气污染物与结核基因，结合分子对接预测污染物与STAT1等蛋白的疏水互作，但核心是污染物-蛋白而非蛋白-DNA互作，且无TF-DNA结合建模，仅部分方法可借鉴。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Air pollution increases tuberculosis (TB) susceptibility, yet the underlying molecular mechanisms remain elusive. METHODS: We integrated human genes associated with seven air pollutants with TB-associated genes from public databases. Utilizing network toxicology, we engineered a diagnostic pipeline evaluating 175 machine learning models across transcriptomic datasets to identify a core gene signature. This signature was validated via qPCR in an independent clinical cohort. Molecular docking and in silico single-cell knockout analyses were used to predict pollutant-protein interactions and potential downstream transcriptional perturbations. RESULTS: We identified 271 intersecting genes enriched in inflammatory and immune-related pathways, including IL-17, TNF, and Toll-like receptor signaling. Machine learning identified a five-gene candidate signature consisting of STAT1, IFIH1, IFIT2, IFIT3, and CYBB. Clinical qRT-PCR further supported their upregulation in TB patients, with individual AUCs ranging from 0.76 to 0.89. Docking simulations predicted that toluene may form hydrophobic interactions with STAT1, IFIT2, and IFIT3. In silico STAT1 perturbation in monocytes predicted transcriptional alterations involving RETN and S100A9, with enrichment in IFN-gamma-related pathways. CONCLUSION: Air pollutants, particularly toluene and benzene, may contribute to TB susceptibility by interacting with interferon-related immune proteins. The identified five-gene signature may represent a potential biomarker panel for TB and warrants further validation in exposure-characterized cohorts.
abstract_zh: 背景：空气污染会增加结核病（TB）的易感性，但其潜在分子机制仍不明确。方法：我们将与七种空气污染物相关的人类基因与公共数据库中的结核病相关基因进行整合。利用网络毒理学，我们构建了一个诊断流程，在转录组数据集中评估了175种机器学习模型，以识别核心基因特征。该特征在独立临床队列中通过qPCR进行了验证。分子对接和计算机模拟单细胞敲除分析用于预测污染物-蛋白质相互作用及潜在的下游转录扰动。结果：我们识别出271个交集基因，富集于炎症和免疫相关通路，包括IL-17、TNF和Toll样受体信号通路。机器学习识别出一个由STAT1、IFIH1、IFIT2、IFIT3和CYBB组成的五基因候选特征。临床qRT-PCR进一步支持其在结核病患者中的上调表达，个体AUC值范围为0.76至0.89。对接模拟预测甲苯可能与STAT1、IFIT2和IFIT3形成疏水相互作用。单核细胞中STAT1的计算机模拟扰动预测了涉及RETN和S100A9的转录改变，并富集于IFN-γ相关通路。结论：空气污染物，尤其是甲苯和苯，可能通过与干扰素相关免疫蛋白相互作用而增加结核病易感性。所识别的五基因特征可能代表结核病的潜在生物标志物组合，并需在暴露特征明确的队列中进一步验证。
